    Uniqueness of the graded Ext of Lemma 6.3 #

    The formalization works with Ext^{n+1}(M, N)_t = 0 in the bar form (GExt.ExtVanish); its agreement with the manuscript's Ext (from graded projective resolutions) is GRes.extVanish_iff in ExtResolutions.lean. This file shows in addition that the definition is forced: any notion of graded Ext vanishing with the standard properties gives the same answer for all the groups Ext^{n+1}_{A₀}(M_i, M_j)_t of Lemma 6.3 (extVanish_unique). The properties are:

    • Ext¹(M, N)_t = 0 exactly when every graded extension 0 → N⟨−t⟩ → E → M → 0 splits;
    • higher Ext of a projective M_p vanishes;
    • dimension shifting along the graded projective cover 0 → K_i → P_i → M_i → 0: Ext^{n+2}(M_i, N)_t = 0 ↔ Ext^{n+1}(K_i, N)_t = 0;
    • additivity over a graded decomposition of K_i into shifted M_j. The bar Ext has them all: extensions (extVanish_zero_iff), projectives (extVanish_proj), dimension shifting in both directions (extVanish_shift, extVanish_unshift), additivity in both directions (extVanish_of_decomp, extVanish_of_retract).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.extVanish_unique {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] {c : MeshCoefficients k Q} {L : CatAlg.LocalFamily (meshFam Q c)} (D : CatAlg.MeshData (meshFam Q c) L) (hfin : ∀ (x y : V), FiniteDimensional k (ScalarMeshCategory.obj c x ⟶ ScalarMeshCategory.obj c y)) [hfd : ∀ (x y : V), FiniteDimensional k (meshFam Q c x ⟶ meshFam Q c y)] (J : D.InjData) (j : V) (E : {X : Type u} → [inst : AddCommGroup X] → [inst_1 : Module k X] → GExt.GMod (galgA0 D hfin) X → ℕ → ℤ → Prop) (hE0 : ∀ (i : V) (t : ℤ), E (gmodEv D hfin i) 0 t ↔ ∀ (X : GExt.GExtn (gmodEv D hfin i) (gmodEv D hfin j) t (CatAlg.Rep D.F0 (meshFam Q c j) × CatAlg.Rep D.F0 (meshFam Q c i))), X.Splits) (hEproj : ∀ (p : D.PV) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ), E (gmodEv D hfin ↑p) n t) (hEshift : ∀ (i : V), ¬D.proj i → ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ), E (gmodEv D hfin i) (n + 1) t ↔ E (KK D hfin i) n t) (hEdecomp : ∀ (i : V) (d : GDecomp D hfin (KK D hfin i) LinearMap.id) (n : ℕ) (t : ℤ), E (KK D hfin i) n t ↔ ∀ (a : d.μ), d.inc a ≠ 0 → E (gmodEv D hfin (d.W a)) n (t + d.s a)) (n : ℕ) (i : V) (t : ℤ) :
    E (gmodEv D hfin i) n t ↔ GExt.ExtVanish (gmodEv D hfin i) (gmodEv D hfin j) n t

    Uniqueness of the graded Ext of Lemma 6.3: any notion E of graded Ext^{n+1}(−, M_j)_t vanishing on graded A₀-modules such that

    • E(M_i, 0, t) holds exactly when every graded extension of M_i by M_j⟨−t⟩ splits,
    • E(M_p, n, t) holds at projective labels,
    • E(M_i, n+1, t) ↔ E(K_i, n, t) along the graded projective cover K_i ↪ P_i ↠ M_i,
    • E(K, n, t) ↔ ∀ a, E(M_{W a}, n, t + s_a) for a graded decomposition K ≅ ⊕_a M_{W a}⟨s_a⟩, agrees with the bar-complex Ext on every Ext^{n+1}_{A₀}(M_i, M_j)_t.
